research_rationale:
EO 14368 of December 18, 2025, Adjustments of Certain Rates of Pay (90 FR 60521; FR Doc. 2025-23844; published December 23, 2025), was read in full from the held Federal Register text. It adopts the 2026 pay schedules (Schedules 1 to 10) for the statutory pay systems, the Senior Executive Service, the Executive Schedule and related offices, the uniformed services, locality payments and administrative law judges, makes Schedule 8 effective January 1, 2026 and the other schedules effective on the first day of the first applicable pay period beginning on or after January 1, 2026, and supersedes EO 14132 of December 23, 2024. On 2026-10-14 no held instrument had amended, revoked or superseded it, and the order has no own-terms end, so every schedule-setting clause is operative on the cutoff. The only held later instrument that names the order is the Office of Personnel Management notice 'January 2026 Pay Schedules', 91 FR 4973 (February 3, 2026), which reports on and implements it; it performs the Federal Register notice step of section 5(b) but does not change the order. The inventory was corrected in two places: the stray fragment '7.' that the dossier listed as its own clause is rejoined to section 3(c), and the dossier's section 4 is split into its two commands (the uniformed-services pay rates and the Director of OPM's assessment directive) because they have different histories.
